hypothesis: Prediction consensus between an early selected snapshot and a final weight average reduces both training-time oscillation and the effects of a single snapshot's localization errors.

candidate.raw_snapshot_selection: highest clean validation mAP across every epoch, ties choose latest
candidate.average_snapshot: uniform end-of-epoch parameters for epochs 61 through 120, final average only
candidate.training_budget_note: Two saved states from the same training trajectory; three expert trajectories, no second training run for snapshots

controls: raw feature fusion at 120 and 360 epochs
two-snapshot feature fusion with the identical snapshot rule

fresh_holdout.policy: All three newly declared confirmatory seeds count. No model evaluation on fresh holdout before all candidate/control hashes freeze; no later tuning against it.

retained_failures: Initial raw consensus clean holdout SD .0456; weight-average-only validation clean SD .0347 over all five exploratory seeds. Neither met the complete goal.
scope: static synthetic three-class oriented 3D detection; known/exposed corruption family
